Service Area

Our California Service Area

As San Pedro‘s first licensed cannabis dispensary, We Roll Up is proud to serve a wide network of communities across the South Bay and greater Los Angeles area. Our commitment to providing a safe, secure, and welcoming environment extends far beyond our dispensary doors. We believe that access to quality cannabis products should be convenient, reliable, and community-driven, which is why we have built strong relationships with customers spanning multiple neighborhoods and cities throughout the region. Whether you are searching for dispensary deals near me or the best weed products near me, our service area is designed to ensure you never have to travel far for an exceptional experience.

Communities We Proudly Serve

Our central location allows us to serve an impressive range of cities and neighborhoods across the South Bay peninsula and surrounding areas. From our home base in San Pedro, we extend our reach to Culver City, Rancho Palos Verdes, Lomita, Wilmington, Harbor City, Torrance, Rolling Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, and Palos Verdes Estates. Each of these communities has its own character, its own culture, and its own relationship with cannabis, and we take the time to understand the unique needs of customers coming from every corner of our service area.

Residents of the Palos Verdes Peninsula, including Rancho Palos Verdes, Rolling Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, and Palos Verdes Estates, benefit from our proximity and our curated selection of premium cannabis products. These communities, known for their scenic beauty and tight-knit neighborhoods, deserve a dispensary that reflects those same values of quality and care. Meanwhile, customers from Torrance, Lomita, Harbor City, and Wilmington appreciate the short drive to our location, where our diverse and knowledgeable team is ready to assist with everything from selecting the perfect flower strain to recommending the ideal edible dosage for a first-time user.

For those coming from Culver City and other parts of the greater Los Angeles area, the journey to We Roll Up is well worth it. Our hand-picked selection of the finest cannabis products at affordable prices sets us apart from other dispensaries in the region. We function as part of the local society and take pride in being a destination that draws visitors from across the South Bay and beyond. We also welcome visitors from anywhere across the country who want to discover the best of cannabinoids, terpenes, and effects.

What Makes Our Service Area Unique

The South Bay cannabis market has evolved significantly in recent years, with California’s legal cannabis industry generating billions in annual revenue and continuing to grow. Within this landscape, the communities we serve represent a diverse cross-section of consumers, from medical patients seeking relief through targeted topicals and concentrates to recreational users exploring vaporizers, pre-rolls, and gummies. Our service area encompasses both densely populated urban neighborhoods and quieter residential enclaves, which means our product selection must cater to an extraordinary range of preferences and needs.

We speak Spanish, and we always have a Spanish-speaking member of our team onsite. This is especially important given the rich cultural diversity of the communities we serve, including Wilmington, San Pedro, and Harbor City, where bilingual service is not just appreciated but essential. Creating an inclusive atmosphere means meeting people where they are, both geographically and linguistically. Recreational users, medical patients, novices, or connoisseurs are all warmly welcome at our location.

Convenience Across Our Service Area

Understanding that our customers lead busy lives, we have implemented multiple ways to make purchasing cannabis products as seamless as possible regardless of where you live within our service area. Our convenience options include:

  • Online ordering allows you to browse our full menu of flower, pre-rolls, vaporizers, edibles, concentrates, and topicals from the comfort of your home in any of the cities we serve
  • In-store pickup lets you place your order ahead of time and walk in to collect it without waiting
  • Curbside pickup provides a quick and easy option for those who prefer to stay in their vehicle, particularly convenient for customers driving in from Torrance, Culver City, or the Palos Verdes communities
  • In-store consultation gives you direct access to our friendly and knowledgeable staff who can guide you through our extensive menu of cannabis products

These options are especially valuable for medical patients throughout our service area who may have mobility challenges or time constraints. We are committed to smoothing your path and ensuring that finding dispensary deals near me never requires unnecessary stress or inconvenience. Our doors are open seven days per week to anyone and everyone from all walks of life.

Our Product Selection Across the Region

No matter which community you call home within our service area, you will find a comprehensive selection of cannabis products tailored to meet your specific needs. Our menu features exceptional smokable flower sourced from top cultivators, available in indica, sativa, and hybrid varieties that span a wide range of potency levels and terpene profiles. For those who prefer convenience, our selection of pre-rolls includes singles, multi-packs, and infused options that deliver consistent quality every time.

Vaporizers have become increasingly popular across our service area, particularly among customers in communities like Palos Verdes Estates and Rolling Hills where discretion and ease of use are valued. We carry a wide variety of vapes, from disposable pens to rechargeable cartridge systems, in numerous strain options and formulations. Our edibles selection features delicious gummies and other treats that provide measured doses for predictable experiences, which is particularly appealing for newer consumers exploring weed products near me for the first time.

Concentrates and topicals round out our offerings, addressing the needs of both experienced users seeking potent effects and medical patients looking for targeted relief without psychoactive experiences. Topicals such as balms, lotions, and patches have seen growing demand from customers throughout the South Bay who are managing chronic pain, inflammation, and skin conditions.

Growing With Our Communities

As the cannabis industry continues to mature in California, We Roll Up remains focused on expanding the quality and depth of service we provide across every city in our service area. Industry trends point toward increased normalization of cannabis consumption, greater emphasis on product testing and transparency, and rising demand for specialized product categories like minor cannabinoids and terpene-rich formulations. We stay ahead of these trends by continuously updating our inventory and training our team to provide informed recommendations.

Finding your perfect strain is our mission. We just love elevating the quality of life for every customer who walks through our doors, whether they are a local from San Pedro or someone making the drive from Culver City. We bring communities together through a supportive atmosphere and quality cannabis products that enrich socialization, bring medicinal relief, and provide options to suit all needs. Our service area is more than a map of cities. It represents the diverse, vibrant community of people we are honored to serve every single day.
